# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_config_reference.py from the settings definition. Do not edit:
     change `Settings` in apps/backend/src/letmehandle/config/settings.py and run
     `make config-reference`. `make verify` fails when this file is out of date. -->

Every variable the backend reads, from `Settings` in
[`apps/backend/src/letmehandle/config/settings.py`](../../apps/backend/src/letmehandle/config/settings.py).
Nothing else in the codebase reads the environment. Values come from the process environment,
then from a `.env` file in the working directory.

**Required** says when a variable must be set; the process refuses to start, naming it, when a
feature that needs it is configured without it. A blank value is the same as an unset one.
**Secret** variables are never logged or rendered in an error. The narrative for each, with
examples, is in [`.env.example`](../../.env.example).

`make sample-env` writes a `.env` that sets the two keys the API cannot start without and leaves
every paid provider unset.

## Application

| Variable | Required | Default | Accepts | Secret | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `APP_ENV` | no | `development` | `development` or `test` or `production` |  | Where the process runs. Production refuses what must never run there, such as the mock sign-in provider. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | no | `info` |  |  | How much is logged. |
| `LOG_FORMAT` | no | `console` | `console` or `json` |  | `json` in production, `console` in development. |

## Database

| Variable | Required | Default | Accepts | Secret | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DATABASE_URL` | when anything is stored: sign-in, calls, migrations | — |  |  | The PostgreSQL database, as `postgresql+asyncpg://user:password@host/db`. |

## Authentication

| Variable | Required | Default | Accepts | Secret | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AUTH_SIGNING_KEY` | when the API starts | — |  | yes | Signs access tokens and keys the refresh-token hash. At least 32 characters, fresh for every deployment; changing it signs everybody out. |
| `AUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS` | no | `900` | ≥ 60, ≤ 3600 |  | How long an access token lives. Short, because it cannot be revoked. |
| `AUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS` | no | `2592000` | ≥ 3600 |  | How long a refresh token lives. Refresh tokens rotate on every use. |
| `OTP_PROVIDER` | no | `mock` | `mock` |  | Who delivers sign-in codes. `mock` delivers nowhere, accepts the development code, and refuses to start in production. |

## Realtime speech and voices

| Variable | Required | Default | Accepts | Secret | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPEECH_PROVIDER` | no | `realtime` | `realtime` or `elevenlabs` |  | Which protocol the speech service speaks. |
| `SPEECH_ENDPOINT_URL` | when the assistant takes calls | — |  |  | The speech service's `ws://` or `wss://` URL. |
| `SPEECH_MODEL` | when the assistant takes calls over `realtime` | — |  |  | The model a `realtime` service runs. |
| `SPEECH_AGENT_ID` | when the assistant takes calls over `elevenlabs` | — |  |  | The agent an `elevenlabs` service talks as. |
| `SPEECH_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL` | no | — |  |  | `realtime` only: the model that writes down what the caller says. Without it only the assistant's side of a call is recorded. |
| `SPEECH_API_KEY` | no | — |  | yes | The speech service's key. Empty for a service that needs none. |
| `SPEECH_VOICES` | when the API starts | — |  |  | The voices offered, as `id:Display name:locale\|locale`, comma-separated. They must be voices the speech service can speak. |
| `SPEECH_DEFAULT_VOICE` | when the API starts | — |  |  | One of the ids in `SPEECH_VOICES`, for a call whose user chose none. |

## Privacy

| Variable | Required | Default | Accepts | Secret | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `TRANSCRIPT_ENCRYPTION_KEYS` | when call history is read or calls are carried | — |  | yes | AES-256-GCM keys for transcripts and summaries, as `id:base64-key` pairs, comma-separated, newest first. |

## Call transport

| Variable | Required | Default | Accepts | Secret | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `TELEPHONY_PROVIDER` | no | — | `twilio` or `android_native`, or empty |  | Which call transport carries calls. Empty carries none. |
| `TELEPHONY_ACCOUNT_ID` | when `TELEPHONY_PROVIDER=twilio` | — |  |  | The telephony account the REST API authenticates as. |
| `TELEPHONY_AUTH_TOKEN` | when `TELEPHONY_PROVIDER=twilio` | — |  | yes | The account's auth token, which signs every callback. |
| `TELEPHONY_NUMBERS` | when `TELEPHONY_PROVIDER=twilio` | — |  |  | The numbers calls are placed from, comma-separated, in E.164 form. |
| `TELEPHONY_APP_ID` | when `TELEPHONY_PROVIDER=twilio` | — |  |  | The provider-side application the assistant joins each call through. |
| `TELEPHONY_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL` | when `TELEPHONY_PROVIDER=twilio` | — |  |  | The public base URL the provider calls back on, exactly as configured there. Signatures are checked against it. |

## Language model

| Variable | Required | Default | Accepts | Secret | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `LLM_BASE_URL` | when the agent judges calls or a model writes summaries; all three together | — |  |  | The OpenAI-compatible endpoint the agent and the summariser use. |
| `LLM_API_KEY` | when the agent judges calls or a model writes summaries; all three together | — |  | yes | The endpoint's key. Any value for a server that checks none. |
| `LLM_MODEL` | when the agent judges calls or a model writes summaries; all three together | — |  |  | The model to ask. |
| `LLM_HEADERS` | no | — |  | yes | Extra headers some gateways ask for, as `Header-Name=value;Other-Header=value`. Cannot set `Authorization`. |
| `LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | no | `20` | > 0, ≤ 120 |  | How long one judgement may take, in seconds, every model turn and tool included. |

## Push notifications

| Variable | Required | Default | Accepts | Secret | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `APNS_KEY_ID` | when any `APNS_` variable is set | — |  |  | The 10-character id of the push token-signing key. |
| `APNS_TEAM_ID` | when any `APNS_` variable is set | — |  |  | The 10-character team id of the developer account. |
| `APNS_PRIVATE_KEY` | when any `APNS_` variable is set | — |  | yes | The .p8 key's content on one line, each newline written as `\n`. |
| `APNS_TOPIC` | when any `APNS_` variable is set | — |  |  | The app's bundle identifier, which notifications are sent to. |
| `APNS_ENVIRONMENT` | when any `APNS_` variable is set | — | `sandbox` or `production`, or empty |  | `sandbox` for development builds, `production` for distributed ones. |
| `FCM_PROJECT_ID` | when any `FCM_` variable is set | — |  |  | The Firebase project id. |
| `FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON` | when any `FCM_` variable is set | — |  | yes | The service account's JSON key, on one line, allowed to send messages. |

## The development stack

Read by `make` and `docker-compose.yml`, not by the backend.

| Variable | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `BACKEND_PORT` | Host port the development stack publishes the backend on. Default `8000`. |
| `POSTGRES_PORT` | Host port the development stack publishes PostgreSQL on. Default `5432`. |
